name: Describing People
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on describing people — practice these key phrases out loud:
She's quite tall, with short brown hair.
He's very easygoing and always up for a laugh.
He has a great sense of humor.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
